Have Compassion on Them Missions

Receive Jesus Christ.
A New Beginning.

Salvation is the free gift of God through Jesus Christ. Learn the message of the cross, repent, and start your discipleship journey today.

1

God Loves You and Has a Divine Purpose

God did not create you for defeat, sin, or eternal condemnation. He created you to know Him and enjoy holy fellowship with Him. His love is eternal, pure, and demonstrated through Jesus.

John 3:16 — “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.”

2

The Reality of Sin & Separation from God

Every person has sinned and fallen short of God’s glory. Sin breaks our relationship with a holy God and produces spiritual death. No amount of good deeds can wash away our sins.

Romans 3:23 — “For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;” and Romans 6:23 — “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.”

3

Jesus Christ Died for You and Rose Again

Because God loved us, He sent His Son Jesus Christ to take our punishment upon Himself on the cross of Calvary. On the third day, He rose again from the dead, conquering sin and death!

Romans 5:8 — “But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.”

4

Repentance, Faith, and Confession

To receive this salvation, you must turn from sin in genuine repentance and surrender your life to Jesus Christ as your personal Lord and Savior.

Romans 10:9–10 — “That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.”

THE PRAYER OF SURRENDER

Pray This Prayer Sincerely

If you desire to surrender your life to Jesus Christ today, pray this prayer out loud from the depth of your heart:

“Lord Jesus Christ, I come to You today recognizing that I am a sinner. I cannot save myself. I believe that You died on the cross for my sins and rose again from the dead. Today, I turn away from all sin and surrender my life to You. Wash me clean with Your precious blood. Come into my heart, be my Savior, and be the Lord of my life. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and grant me the grace to follow You all the days of my life. Thank You Lord for saving me. In Jesus’ name, Amen!”

🎉 I Gave My Life to Jesus Today! I Rededicated My Life

Next Steps for Your New Life in Christ

When you give your life to Jesus, you become a brand-new creation (2 Cor 5:17). Here are vital steps to grow:

  • Pray Daily: Speak with God every day in prayer as your heavenly Father (1 Thess 5:17).
  • Read God’s Word: Start reading the New Testament (begin with the Gospel of John).
  • Christian Fellowship: Find a true Bible-believing, Christ-centered church fellowship.
  • Get Discipled: Contact HCTM on WhatsApp so we can pray with you and send discipleship materials.
